extra_vocab.zh: 軟鎖定（輕度固定，施力即可克服）
extra_vocab.en: a light lock that holds a part in place but can be moved with some force
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 soft-lock 當名詞修飾 mechanism，指用來把握把暫時固定在中間位置的輕度機構。它不是完全鎖死，使用者用手施力就能轉回去，和 full lock（完全鎖定）相對。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: soft-lock 放在名詞前面當修飾語時用單數，連字號不能省略，例如 a soft-lock mechanism，不寫 soft-locks mechanism。

example.en: Both soft-locks on the cart hold the frame in position.
example.zh: 推車上的兩個軟鎖定都能把車架固定在位置上。

example.en: Once the handle is soft-locked, it will not swing back.
example.zh: 握把一旦被軟鎖定，就不會擺回去。

example.en: Our engineers are testing a new soft-lock mechanism for the folding frame.
example.zh: 我們的工程師正在測試折疊車架的新軟鎖定機構。

example.en: Adding a soft-lock to the door would reduce accidental openings.
example.zh: 在門上加裝軟鎖定可以減少意外打開。

example.en: Pull the lever gently to release the soft-lock before folding.
example.zh: 折疊前請輕拉拉桿以解除軟鎖定。

example.en: The soft-lock feature makes the product easier to use with one hand.
example.zh: 軟鎖定功能讓產品單手使用更容易。

examples.en: We could add a soft-lock to keep the lid closed during transport.
examples.zh: 我們可以加一個軟鎖定，讓蓋子在運送時保持關閉。

examples.en: The soft-lock holds the handle in place, but users can still override it.
examples.zh: 軟鎖定把握把固定在原位，但使用者仍然可以強制轉動它。

examples.en: Please review the soft-lock design and send me your comments by Friday.
examples.zh: 請檢視軟鎖定的設計，並在週五前把意見寄給我。

examples.en: The quality team asked whether a soft-lock counts as a full lock.
examples.zh: 品質團隊問軟鎖定是否算是完全鎖定。

confusable.diff: block 是「擋住、阻礙」或「塊狀物」，lock 才是「鎖住」，拼法只差一個字母。

example.en: A block of wood stopped the wheel, but it was not a lock.
example.zh: 一塊木頭擋住了輪子，但那不是鎖。

similar.diff: latch 是門或蓋子上的扣鎖或門閂，通常一扣就固定；soft-lock 強調固定力道輕、可被施力克服。

example.en: The latch on the cabinet door broke during the delivery.
example.zh: 櫃門上的扣鎖在運送途中壞了。

similar.diff: temporary lock 強調「暫時」鎖住，soft-lock 強調「力道輕、不是完全鎖死」。

example.en: We added a temporary lock to protect the display during shipping.
example.zh: 我們加了一個暫時鎖，在運送時保護展示品。

example.en: The lock keeps the wheels from turning while the cart is parked.
example.zh: 車子停放時，這個鎖能防止輪子轉動。

example.en: Make sure the latch is closed before you move the box.
example.zh: 搬動箱子前請確認扣鎖已經扣好。

example.en: The brake keeps the stroller from rolling on a slope.
example.zh: 煞車能避免嬰兒車在斜坡上滑動。
